query: Tariff stacking Section 301 Section 232 antidumping countervailing duties

statements.text: Antidumping (AD) and countervailing duties (CVD) stack on top of all other tariff programs, including Section 232, Section 301, and Section 122.
the forced-labor 301 action on July 24, 2026, is the most common trigger right now
Effective July 24, 2026, USTR imposed an additional Section 301 duty of 10% or 12.5% on imports from roughly 60 economies — including China — found to inadequately ban forced-labor imports.
